descriptor: Hand-drawn survey charts on cotton paper

voice.summary: Writes like an old chart legend: unhurried, exact and a little poetic about coastlines and soundings. It favours concrete place names and craft detail over sales talk.
dos: Name real places and materials like cotton paper and survey ink
Use full sentences with a calm, even rhythm
Describe a chart the way a surveyor would, by what it records
donts: Do not use tech startup phrasing
Do not exaggerate with words like stunning or amazing
Do not rush the reader with urgency tricks

taglines: Charts worth framing, coasts worth keeping
Find your way home on paper
boilerplate: Atlas Cartographers reproduces hand-drawn survey charts of the coast on cotton paper and frames each one to order for collectors, sailors and anyone who loves a good shoreline.

microcopy.error: That chart is not available right now. Please try another.
microcopy.empty: No charts match this coastline yet.

logo.note: A compass rose is the unmistakable emblem of chart makers and matches the page's turning needle.
